name: Alistair Davies
bio:
Alistair's journey into motorsport began with a childhood fascination for dismantling and rebuilding radios. This curiosity led him to pursue a degree in Electrical Engineering, after which he spent several years honing his skills in the aerospace industry. The lure of speed and competition eventually proved too strong, and he transitioned to motorsport, initially working with smaller racing teams before joining CLRT by Almeras. His calm and methodical approach to problem-solving is highly valued by the team.

Alistair is known for his meticulous attention to detail and his ability to quickly diagnose and resolve complex electronic issues. He thrives under pressure, often finding innovative solutions when others are struggling. While he appreciates the technical advancements in modern racing, he also believes in the importance of understanding the fundamental principles behind the technology, ensuring that the team isn't overly reliant on black-box solutions.

What sets Alistair apart is his dedication to mentoring younger engineers. He actively seeks to share his knowledge and experience, fostering a collaborative environment within the team. He believes that the future of motorsport depends on nurturing the next generation of talent, and he takes pride in playing a part in their development.

physical.hairStyle: Short, neatly combed, thinning on top
physical.description: Alistair is of average height with a slightly stocky build, his face etched with the lines of experience.

quirks: Always carries a small multi-tool in his pocket.
Insists on using a physical notebook for all his calculations and notes, despite the availability of digital tools.
Frequently hums classical music while working, much to the amusement of his younger colleagues.
